name: Ganesha Ecoverse Limited
about: Ganesha Ecoverse Limited engages in the trading of post-consumer PET bottle waste and scrap. The company also trades and sales in various kinds of plastic and textile products. The company was formerly known as SVP Housing Limited and changed its name to Ganesha Ecoverse Limited in August 2023. Ganesha Ecoverse Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Rampur, India
